name: MTM (Medical Transportation Management) (Partner)
assessment: Expect a typing and personality assessment
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED, required. Bachelor's degree preferred
Required Experience: 2+ years of customer service experience, 1+ year of experience training others
Preferred Experience: Bachelor's degree
Required Skills:
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
Ability to work with little direct supervision
Strong problem-solving and ability to take charge of difficult situations
Ability to build relationships and communicate at all levels, internally and externally
Ability to explain complex topics clearly and engagingly
Data management, reporting, and high attention to detail
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with a couple years of customer service experience and at least a year training others who wants to move into a more strategic, relationship-driven role
Someone who genuinely enjoys public speaking, presenting, and building trust with external partners
Someone comfortable working independently and managing their own priorities across a market
Someone who likes digging into data to find patterns and recommend real improvements
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone without prior training experience, this is a specific required qualification, not just customer service background
Anyone who prefers a desk-based, single-task role over a varied, relationship-heavy position involving travel to local facilities
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Community outreach
Training and facilitation
Stakeholder relationship management
Healthcare transportation coordination
Data analysis and reporting
Process improvement
Presentation development
Compliance and risk management
Customer service
Microsoft Office Suite
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience training others, either formally or informally.
Walk us through how you'd build a relationship with a new facility or partner in your market.
How do you use data to identify a problem and develop a solution?
Describe a time you had to explain something complex to a group in a clear, engaging way.
How do you prioritize your day when managing multiple facilities, deadlines, and stakeholder needs at once?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $47,920 to $62,900 annually, roughly $23 to $30 per hour as an estimate, based on national market data and may vary by location
Shift: Not specified in the posting, full-time role
Benefits: Health and life insurance, dental and vision plans, 401(k) with company match, PTO and holiday pay, maternity/paternity leave, casual dress environment, tuition reimbursement, and an employee perks discount program
Equipment Provided: Not specified in the posting, and no internet requirement is listed either. Confirm both during the recruiter screen
Felony Friendly?: MTM states it considers qualified candidates with a criminal history in a manner consistent with applicable local, state, and federal law, worth noting as a more open stance than many employers
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is a strong growth opportunity for a participant with solid customer service experience and some background training or mentoring others, offering a real step up in both pay and responsibility. The relationship-building and public-facing nature of the role means it's a great fit for someone with genuine people skills who wants more variety than a typical desk job, and MTM's stated openness to candidates with a criminal history is worth highlighting.
Career Pathway: Trainer, Community Outreach → Senior Community Outreach Trainer → Community Outreach Manager or Training Program Manager
